changes: Home contains native HungerStation start and Compare actions, progress, errors and request-bound fresh totals; legacy restaurant catalog entry and automatic refresh removed.
Compare from Octopus reacquires the observed source basket and fresh menu-footer proof before importing it.
Prefer the native Add items cart control to return to the source restaurant menu. A known Home landing uses exact restaurant search and unchanged-cart verification.
Source edit-sheet reader supports observed plain required radio rows, overlapping clipped rows, optional limits up to 24 and positive native scroll-end metadata.
Terra is consulted after stalled screen reading or a source Home landing, with at most three distinct proposals per native session and no cart mutation replay.
limitations: Configured transfer remains one meal, quantity one, with required single-choice selections and no selected optional additions.
A matching Keeta basket is revalidated without another Add; a different nonempty basket is rejected, not automatically replaced.
Local source replay, emulator UI and synthetic cloud approval do not prove a complete live provider comparison.
privacy: No actual basket details, private captures, account data, tokens or signing material included.
